meta.name: Below
meta.description: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a small Newfoundland town, a hard-bitten fisherman and his family fight to protect their close-knit community.

videos.title: Come Home Year
videos.overview: Calvin Penney welcomes his family home for a long-awaited reunion as an unexpected arrival makes waves throughout the coastal town of Snooks Arm.

videos.title: Crown and Anchor
videos.overview: Calvin teams up with marine researcher Dr. Fonda Howander to investigate strange events, while his son Wade tries to make sense of unsettling dreams.

videos.title: Sir John Franklin
videos.overview: Wade and Calvin encounter mysterious newcomers. Fonda warns the town's residents about a nautical threat as unease spreads through the community.

videos.title: The Ocean Will Have Us All
videos.overview: As outsiders draw Calvin into a dangerous hunt for the creature, an unseen danger begins closing in on his family and everyone else in town.

videos.title: Little Pot Rock
videos.overview: Calvin uncovers shocking truths about his past. Fonda makes a startling discovery as unexpected company arrives.

videos.title: The Unfathering Deep
videos.overview: As the true motives behind the crisis become clear and an evacuation begins, Calvin, his family and Fonda devise a risky plan to save their town.
